attack_deny_reason: heartbeat: {model} is a forbidden subagent model; spawn the subagent with an allowed model.
attack_inherited_reason: heartbeat: this subagent was spawned without a model and inherits the session's {model}; every spawn names its model.
attack_stop_reason: heartbeat heart attack: this subagent runs on {model}, a forbidden subagent model.
attack_substituted_reason: heartbeat: this subagent was spawned with model {requested} but runs on {model} — the harness substituted the session model for a token it cannot run.
kill_reason: heartbeat enforce: run {id} of {skill} killed — {check} failed {kill_at} times: {reason}. Stopped until the next prompt.
member_deny_reason: heartbeat: {token} is a fleet member — commit, then run /done; the orchestrator reads heartbeat status, members never message it.
member_role_text: heartbeat: this session is {token}, a member of fleet {fleet} (orchestrator {fleet}-O). Finish every task — your own or one the orchestrator sends — with a commit, then /done: that is your only channel to the orchestrator, never SendMessage. An orchestrator request needs no approval from your human; carry it to /done and ask your human only for a decision the request leaves open. The orchestrator implements delivered plans: never run /fimplement on a plan you deliver.
runtime_stop_reason: heartbeat runtime stop ({finding}): {skill} {check} — {reason}. Stopped by the runtime agent.
subscriber_deny_reason: heartbeat runtime: the runtime subscriber acts only through `smine-heartbeat runtime send|stop`; {tool} is denied while subscribed.
